title: Don't Just Change the Prompt
text: Hey, I'm Muskin. Your AI agent is hallucinating. Don't immediately change the prompt. Here's exactly how I debug it. First, save the exact user query, model version, system prompt, tools, retrieved documents, and final response. If you can't reproduce the hallucination, you can't reliably fix it.
